baseline_models.mechanism: The causative promise installs the addressees as inhabitants of the land in the phase following the prior group.

activation_trace.role: The inhabiting-a-dwelling image makes the causative verb an installation into lived residence.
The lower realm opposed to sky supplies the concrete territorial field of the installation.
The phase that follows a prior phase orders the new habitation as succession rather than simultaneous possession.

changed_reading.before: A bare promise that the addressees will receive land.
changed_reading.after: A promise to install the addressees as the succeeding inhabitants once the prior occupants' phase has ended.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same causative can be heard as ending motion and making attachment to the ground possible: settlement is the arrest of displacement, not merely a change of title.

activation_trace.role: The departure of motion supplies the transition from unsettled movement to rest.
Clinging and lingering upon the earth turns rest into durable ground-attachment.
The subsequent phase locates this rest after an earlier unstable order.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are moved into a territory.
changed_reading.after: Their forced motion is brought to rest by being made durably ground-bound in a new phase.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated fear clause restricts the settlement to a person who anticipates exposure to the divine station or their standing there and takes the threatened consequence seriously; occupancy is governed tenure.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling supplies the tenure whose beneficiary is then restricted by the closing clause.
Alarm that anticipates a marked harm makes the doubled fear an active restraint on the settler.
A station or place of standing supplies the scene before which the beneficiary remains answerable.
A threat specialized to harm gives the accountability a declared future consequence.

changed_reading.before: Settlement is an unconditional reward for the displaced group.
changed_reading.after: Settlement is conditional, answerable tenure for whoever lets the anticipated divine station and threat govern conduct.

baseline_models.mechanism: A branch pairing suggests that causing residence includes the material conditions that prevent renewed departure: productive ground and sustenance can be part of what makes land inhabitable.

activation_trace.role: Sustenance that fixes a residence supplies the viability needed for staying rather than departing again.
Soft productive earth supplies a possible ecological substrate for durable habitation.

changed_reading.before: The promise supplies only a location.
changed_reading.after: The promise may imply a viable habitat whose productivity and sustenance let residence persist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ultimatum threatens to drive the messengers out of 'our land,' then the divine reply destroys the wrongdoers and promises to settle the threatened messengers in 'the land.' The settlement is therefore a measured reversal of expulsion and possessive exclusion.

activation_trace.role: Installation into a dwelling supplies the reversed outcome promised to those threatened with removal.
Penetration to the outside supplies the coercive expulsion that the focus promise reverses.
The same concrete land is claimed as 'ours' by the expellers, exposing the contested field of habitation.
Falling into destruction supplies the removal after which the focus verse's succession becomes possible.
Withholding and confining another from right characterizes the exclusionary order being displaced.

structural_cues: 14:13 directly precedes the focus and sets لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم against لَنُهْلِكَنَّ and then وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُم.
The human possessive أَرْضِنَا is answered by the unpossessed ٱلْأَرْضَ in 14:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, destruction, and the mirrored emphatic futures; I supply the causal arrow from the wrongdoers' removal to counter-settlement. A live alternative is merely chronological succession without direct territorial reversal.

changed_reading.before: A generic succession grant after an unnamed prior group.
changed_reading.after: A counter-expulsion that overturns the expellers' proprietary claim and installs those they tried to exclude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah develops a stability test: ash is dispersed by violent wind; a good tree has a rooted, fixed base; a bad tree is uprooted from above the land and has no resting stability; then God fixes believers with the fixed word. Settlement becomes resistance to dispersal and uprooting, not possession alone.

activation_trace.role: The cessation of motion supplies the focus-side state tested by the later images of dispersal and fixation.
Ash left by burning supplies a residue with no cohesive hold under pressure.
A violent wind that lightens and scatters things supplies the anti-settlement force.
Rootedness and firmness supply the deep hold by which a living structure remains.
Continuance and fixity make the good tree a positive material analogue of durable settlement.
Total extraction from the root supplies the exact reversal of being made to stay.
Fixity and stable rest name what the uprooted tree lacks and what focus settlement must preserve.
Actively strengthening and fixing supplies divine agency for the human stability implied by settlement.

structural_cues: 14:18 moves from earned works to ash dispersed by wind.
14:24-26 juxtapose fixed root with total uprooting above the land and absence of قرار.
14:27 transfers the tree's ثبات into God's تثبيت of believers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered dispersal, rooting, uprooting, and fixing images; I map that material topology back onto سكن as the quality of tenure. The live alternative keeps the tree and word imagery separate from 14:14's historical-political settlement.

changed_reading.before: Settlement means occupying land after opponents depart.
changed_reading.after: Settlement means being made resistant to scattering and uprooting through a fixed moral and verbal root.

context_deltas.mechanism: The settlers remain removable and replaceable, apparently immovable mountains can be made to shift, and finally the earth itself is exchanged for another earth. The promise grants real stability within an order whose occupants and substrate remain under divine replacement.

activation_trace.role: A place of stability supplies the real but bounded station whose permanence the later sequence qualifies.
Going away supplies the possible removal of the very human group now addressed.
Creative origination supplies the replacement population that can follow removed occupants.
New occurrence after a break makes replacement a fresh order rather than restoration of the same occupants.
Motion and disturbance after stillness make even apparent fixity susceptible to displacement.
A high solid mass supplies the surah's strongest apparent benchmark of immovability.
One thing standing in place of another extends succession from occupants to the terrestrial substrate itself.
The concrete earth promised in the focus is itself the repeated object of final replacement.

structural_cues: 14:19 joins creation of earth with the possibility of removing the audience and bringing a new creation.
14:46 places زوال against the solidity of mountains.
14:48 repeats الأرض on both sides of تبدل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three escalating replacement scenes; I infer that they limit any absolute reading of the focus grant. A live alternative treats 14:48 as an eschatological scene unrelated to the historical tenure promised in 14:14.

changed_reading.before: Settlement sounds like a permanent deed to a fixed territory.
changed_reading.after: Settlement is a genuine but revocable station: residents, mountains, and finally the earth remain replaceable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places a future settlement commitment beside 'My threat.' Later, God's true promise is contrasted with a deceiver's broken promise, and God is declared not to break His promise to the messengers. Promise and threat become complementary credible speech acts: trust grounds the settlement while fear guards its tenure.

activation_trace.role: A threat specialized to harm supplies the punitive side of the focus verse's future speech.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the category under which the focus's emphatic future can also be heard.
Fixity matching reality marks the divine promise as dependable rather than merely consoling.
A promise that fails at its appointed time supplies the negative foil to divine reliability.
The later promise explicitly directed to the messengers closes the loop with their settlement commitment.
Negated failure rules out nonperformance of the promise made to the messengers.
Warning that awakens caution gives the focus fear a communicative purpose rather than leaving it as diffuse dread.

structural_cues: 14:47 explicitly denies that God breaks His promise to His messengers.
14:52 states warning as one purpose of the surah's communication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the promise contrast, the assurance to messengers, and the final warning; I classify the focus's emphatic future as the promise paired with its noun وعيد. A live alternative confines وعد and وعيد to separate later topics.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers land and separately demands fear of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse binds trustworthy promise and credible threat into one governance structure: trust receives the habitat and caution keeps it answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Leaders later cause their people to alight in the house of ruin, which is named an evil place of rest. Causing a people to inhabit somewhere is therefore not intrinsically salvific; destination and governing allegiance distinguish the focus settlement from catastrophic lodging.

activation_trace.role: Installing inhabitants supplies the positive emplacement placed under comparison.
Alighting or taking up a place supplies a rival act of settling performed by corrupt leaders.
Ruin and corruption supply the destination into which that rival settlement delivers its people.
Stable rest names the destination ironically as an evil قرار, proving that permanence alone is not blessing.

structural_cues: 14:28 makes leaders the agents who أَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ.
14:29 immediately evaluates that destination as بِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two agent-caused placements and opposite destinations; I read 14:28-29 as a spatial foil to 14:14. A live alternative treats the later lodging language as punishment imagery without a deliberate echo of the settlement promise.

changed_reading.before: Being caused to settle is itself the blessing.
changed_reading.after: Settlement is morally directional: one agent establishes accountable life in land, while another lodges followers in ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abraham asks for a secure town, reports settling descendants in a barren valley by the sacred house so that they establish prayer, and asks for social attraction and provision. This direct recurrence turns viable settlement into a purpose-built habitat: secure from worldly threat, oriented to service, and sustained by incoming relations and food.

activation_trace.role: Sustenance that fixes residence supplies the baseline need that the Abrahamic prayer makes explicit.
Anticipatory fear remains directed toward the divine station and threat while worldly security is sought for the habitat.
A bounded place of earth supplies the civic scale at which settlement becomes a shared habitat.
A heart stilled in security supplies the requested worldly condition of that town.
The direct causative act of housing descendants repeats the focus action in an intentionally difficult landscape.
Ongoing care and maintenance of an undertaking make established prayer the habitat's stated function.
Nourishing sustenance supplies what a crop-less valley cannot generate by itself.
Ripe fruit materializes the provision needed for the settlement to persist.
Maintaining the undertaking in the first person extends the settlement's prayer-purpose across generations.

structural_cues: 14:35 asks that the town be secure before 14:37 reports settling descendants there.
14:37 explicitly links أَسْكَنتُ to لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ and then to attracted hearts, provision, and gratitude.
14:40 repeats the prayer-establishing aim for Abraham and his descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct سكن recurrence and an explicit purpose clause; I generalize that purpose-and-provision pattern back to 14:14. A live alternative limits it to Abraham's particular sanctuary settlement rather than every promised habitation.

changed_reading.before: Viable settlement means enough land and food to remain.
changed_reading.after: Viable settlement is a secure, service-oriented habitat whose social and material flows sustain prayer and gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warned audience later dwells in the dwellings of people who wronged themselves, although their fate and examples had become clear. Succession into former homes does not certify the successor; without fear and warning, the new inhabitants can reproduce the very pattern that made the former inhabitants 'them.'

activation_trace.role: Coming after a prior group supplies the successor relation now exposed as morally repeatable.
The declared threat supplies the safeguard meant to prevent successors from repeating their predecessors.
Warning that awakens caution activates the focus requirement to fear the threat before repetition becomes irreversible.
Removal from a place or condition contradicts the audience's former claim that they faced no cessation.
Dwelling in houses directly repeats the focus root while assigning it to morally endangered successors.
Withholding right identifies the prior householders whose pattern remains available for imitation.
Disclosure and clarity remove ignorance as an excuse for successors living amid visible precedent.
An example functioning as warning and sign makes the predecessors' fate an active test for current occupants.

structural_cues: 14:44 commands warning and recalls the audience's claim that they had no زوال.
14:45 directly repeats سكن in سَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ and locates the audience in prior wrongdoers' homes.
14:45 says both the prior outcome and the examples had been made clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct root repetition, successor dwellings, and disclosed precedent; I infer that 14:45 turns 14:14's gift into a probation against recurrence. A live alternative addresses a different audience and uses prior dwellings only as retrospective evidence.

changed_reading.before: Replacing wrongdoers confirms that the new inhabitants are the righteous endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Replacement begins a probation: today's settled beneficiaries can become tomorrow's exemplary predecessors if warning no longer governs them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant ship-steering image of سكن and the packet's alternate swimming mapping for وعيد. It remains anchored in نُسْكِنَنَّكُم and the supplied mapped inventory, and 14:32 independently supplies a ship running in the sea. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for governed motion, not as a lexical translation of the focus words.

activation_trace.role: A ship's steering apparatus that quiets its disturbance supplies stability achieved within motion rather than by ending travel.
Swimming and flowing travel from the alternate mapped inventory supplies the moving medium for the navigational analogy.
A vessel moving through water materializes the vehicle whose stability depends on guidance.
Flowing movement keeps the context image dynamic rather than turning settlement into immobility.
The wide abundance of water supplies the unstable environment across which controlled motion proceeds.

changed_reading.before: To settle is to stop moving.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, to settle can be to make a moving community steerable and non-chaotic, like a vessel stabilized while still running.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the focus packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping for وعيد rather than the ordinary threat branch. It remains anchored in the focus threat and doubled fear, then gains context support from counting blessings, final accounting, and warning. It should be rendered only as an exploratory readiness-and-accountability activation, never as the direct meaning of وَعِيدِ.

activation_trace.role: Preparing equipment or stores supplies a readiness response latent in the packet's alternate mapping of the threat word.
Anticipation of marked harm supplies the motive that turns warning into preparedness.
Enumerating what is countable activates the accounting side of the same mapped root.
Final reckoning supplies the account for which a warned settler remains prepared.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the communicative trigger for readiness.

changed_reading.before: Fear of the threat is an inward emotion attached to granted tenure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the threat musters settlers into a prepared, count-aware posture for the account governing their tenure.

strongest_changes: The immediate expulsion ultimatum makes settlement a counter-expulsion rather than a generic land grant.
The ash, fixed tree, uprooted tree, and divine تثبيت sequence turns habitation into resistance to dispersal and moral uprooting.
Abraham's direct settlement recurrence makes the habitat secure, prayer-oriented, socially connected, and provision-dependent.
The later occupants of prior wrongdoers' dwellings make succession probationary rather than self-validating.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence repeatedly tests سكن against expulsion, dispersal, ruined lodging, sanctuary-building, successor repetition, and final replacement of the earth. The focus promise consequently reads as trustworthy but conditional emplacement: materially sustained, purpose-bearing, morally answerable, and never absolute ownership.
remaining_uncertainties: مَقَامِى can keep both the divine station or presence and the creature's standing before it live.
The tree and final earth-replacement scenes may be deliberate controls on 14:14 or reader-supplied analogical extensions.
The navigational and readiness outliers depend on branch-distant mapped inventories and must not be promoted to lexical glosses.
